function.name: get_payoff_matrix
function.description: Return the payoff matrix for a named 2-player 2-action symmetric game. The result is an object with row_actions (list of strings), col_actions (list of strings), and matrix (2x2 array of [row_payoff, col_payoff] pairs). matrix[i][j] is the payoff pair when the row player plays row_actions[i] and the column player plays col_actions[j].

game_name.description: Name of the game to fetch.
